tool.name: RhizAeon
tool.command: ln -s '$input' input.fasta && rhizaeon --input input.fasta --output '$summary_json' --landmarks $landmarks --alpha $alpha --poisson-floor $poisson_floor --tier2-stringency $tier2_stringency --tier3-stringency $tier3_stringency #if $compression == "compress": --compress-snps #elif $compression == "no_compress": --no-compress-snps #end if #if str($title): --title '$title' #end if #if $emit_viz: --viz '$viz_json' #end if #if $emit_html: --html '$dashboard_html' #end if

param.label: Input alignment
param.help: Aligned FASTA of nucleotide sequences to scan for recombination

param.label: Landmarks
param.help: Target number of landmarks K on the simplex

param.label: Significance alpha
param.help: Family-wise significance level for event verification

param.label: Poisson floor
param.help: Minimum supporting informative sites required to call an event

param.label: Tier 2 stringency
param.help: Filter stringency multiplier for trajectory and donor attribution; below 1.0 relaxes, above 1.0 increases stringency

param.label: Tier 3 stringency
param.help: Filter stringency multiplier for sequence and topological due diligence; below 1.0 relaxes, above 1.0 increases stringency

param.name: compression
param.label: SNP compression
param.help: Restrict scanning to parsimony-informative SNPs, or scan the full physical sequence. Auto triggers for L > 30kb, L > 10kb with N >= 48, or N*L > 2M at L >= 10kb; alignments under 10kb always scan full sites.

param.label: Report title
param.help: Custom title for the visualization dossier and HTML dashboard

param.name: emit_viz
param.label: Emit visualization dossier
param.help: Write the rich visualization JSON dossier in addition to the scan summary

param.name: emit_html
param.label: Emit HTML dashboard
param.help: Write the standalone interactive HTML dashboard

tool.help:
RhizAeon: Phylo-Attention Force Field Recombination Scanner =============================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
Did recombination occur in this alignment, and if so, which taxa are recombinant, which parents contributed, and where do the tracts begin and end?
**How it works**
RhizAeon projects alignment columns onto a phylo-attention force field defined over a landmark simplex. It screens candidate recombinant taxa, then verifies tracts under Fisher/Poisson significance floors, with additional trajectory/donor-attribution (Tier 2) and sequence/topological due-diligence (Tier 3) filters. Unsampled donor parents are reported as ghost donors.
**Inputs**
- An aligned nucleotide FASTA file
**Outputs**
- **Scan summary (JSON)**: informative-site count, screened candidates, and verified events with tract coordinates, parents, p-values, and Z-scores - **Visualization dossier (JSON, optional)**: the full dossier powering downstream plots - **Interactive dashboard (HTML, optional)**: standalone report
